question: The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2011 has added a new Directive Principle of State Policy related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cooperative Societies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2011 added a new Directive Principle of State Policy related to **Cooperative Societies**.
 
• This amendment aimed at encouraging the formation, autonomy, and democratic functioning of cooperative societies.
 
• It introduced Part IXB in the Constitution which is dedicated to cooperative societies, ensuring their free and fair management and operations.
 
• The amendment aims to ensure better governance, accountability, and transparency in the functioning of cooperative societies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**

 
 
• DPSPs are guidelines or principles given to the federal institutes governing the state of India, to be kept in consideration while framing laws and policies.
 
• These principles are aimed at ensuring social and economic democracy and achieving the welfare state.
 
• They are non-justiciable in nature, meaning they are not enforceable by any court but are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• The DPSPs are listed in Part IV of the Indian Constitution from Articles 36 to 51.
 
 
 
• **97th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2011**
 
 
• This amendment provided constitutional status and protection to cooperative societies.
 
• It aimed to ensure that cooperative societies function in a democratic, professional, autonomous, and economically sound manner.
 
• The amendment introduced Part IXB to the Constitution, which contains provisions related to the incorporation, regulation, and dissolution of cooperative societies.
 
• It also added Article 43B in the Directive Principles of State Policy, which states that the State shall endeavor to promote voluntary formation, autonomous functioning, democratic control, and professional management of cooperative societies.
 
 
 
• **Cooperative Societies**
 
 
• Cooperative societies are voluntary associations of individuals who come together to achieve a common economic objective.
 
• They operate on the principles of self-help, mutual help, and democratic management.
 
• These societies play a crucial role in sectors like agriculture, credit, marketing, housing, and production in India.
 
• The primary objective of a cooperative society is to provide support to its members and work towards their economic upliftment.
